svg.text: PostgreSQL is the only stock authority • outbox in Postgres, BullMQ only runs jobs • one isolated queue + worker per channel
AWS ap-south-1 · VPC · ECS Fargate (api service + worker service, autoscaled 2–6 tasks)
worker service · BullMQ jobs on Redis · each queue has a DLQ
No outbound calls on this path
Enqueue due rows; recover lost jobs
GET by key, then POST; drains after Sunday
Stock pushers: 1 queue + 1 worker per channel (isolated)
API 2 rps · 5 s timeout, 3 tries + CSV
Each channel has its own queue, worker,
Down 1–2 h on Sundays: outbox holds
Urgent REST API + daily CSV upload
Retry resets the job, never creates a new order
Solid arrows: data flow • Dashed: queued work / shared control • Workers read and write PostgreSQL directly (stock_channel_state, erp_outbox)
Correctness lives in PostgreSQL transactions; Redis and queues improve delivery, never inventory authority.
